about_the_game:
Stolen Blood is a first-person mystical horror game inspired by European folklore. Haunted by visions, you uncover a tragic past of family, curses, and death. These visions flow from your very blood—they call to you. Once you understand your past, only one question remains: whose soul will you save?

Gameplay

The dialogues and the protagonist’s monologues will guide you on your journey, whether in the real world or in a vision where ancient spirits will send you their messages. Explore the various locations that may be connected to these visions. Listen carefully to make the decision you believe is most appropriate in the end. Be the judge of the guilty souls!

Story

You are a simple peasant child living with your mother on a farm. You do the household chores, rest on your favorite meadow, but one day your fate changes in the forest. A force takes hold of you that you have never known, and deep inside, you feel that what is happening to you is far from ordinary. Investigate the connection between your family and these bloody visions!

Atmosphere and Setting

The Central European peasant world blends with mystical horror elements, while Hungarian folk-inspired melodies and eerie musical elements enrich the overall atmosphere.
